guide.step1.title: Install AltStore
guide.step1.text: Get AltStore on your iOS 17.4+ device - it's the gateway that Apple couldn't fully close. Visit AltStore.io in Safari browser and tap "Install."
guide.step2.title: Add Freedom Store source to AltStore
guide.step2.text: Once AltStore is installed, open it and add Freedom Store as a source. Tap "Sources" → "Add Source" and enter: source.freedomstore.io.

footer.subtitle: Freedom Store loves Freedom Tech
footer.privacy: We count visits with Fathom Analytics, which uses no cookies. Fathom receives your IP address and browser details, uses them only to tell visits apart with a key that changes daily, and does not keep them. We see only totals: pages viewed, the referring site, browser, device type and country. Fathom processes this data for us in the EU. We rely on our legitimate interest in knowing how this site is used.
